messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. The corridor has two long sides, the window side and the shop side. You are 0.9 m from the window side. Is the window side on your left or on your right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Left
Because Person 2 is facing you from 6 m ahead, their right corresponds to your left; since they are in the middle and you are 0.9 m from the window side (less than half of 1.75 m), the window side is on your left.
